scope: Seven further duplicate-source training pairs from duplicate_conflict_review_queue_round33.json. Both kept and dropped V frames and kept T frames were visually inspected; T labels compared without assigning cross-sensor physical identities.
decision_scope: Presence and approximate visible object count only; exact bounding boxes remain pending and this is not a training-label version.

pairs.finding: Both V labels contain flame but differ markedly in extent. The dropped smoke label is not independently confirmed by the visible frame. Redraw flame and resolve smoke before training.
The retained V label omits smoke and covers only a small lower flame area; dropped labels should not be copied without geometry review.
Retained V label omits smoke; dropped smoke box spans almost the entire frame and is not a usable object box.

The V labels disagree on one broad versus two small smoke boxes; only the left plume is clearly established. Thermal frame contains three distinct bright target regions, while each existing T label version lists only two and targets different regions.
The V smoke box geometry differs. The retained T label has two boxes and omits a third clearly bright lower-left region; the dropped T label has three, but geometry still needs review.
Both V labels list two smoke targets but disagree on extent. The retained T label lists only the left hot region; the right hot region is omitted.

The retained V label omits the right smoke plume. The retained T label has two boxes over the left region and omits the distinct right hot region; dropped T labels have different positions and require redrawing.
